candidates.hardening: Nonlinear density pressure; not finite-strain hardening.
candidates.finite_deformation: Supports vortices and large phase gradients.
candidates.weak_field: Linearization gives acoustic dispersion.
candidates.large_deformation: Dispersion dominates at short scales; no shear modulus.
candidates.weaknesses: Imports complex field, hbar, mass and coupling; wrong native variable.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Would replace rather than instantiate the frozen C-based ontology.

evaluation.recovery: Hamiltonian but not recovery of an elastic C state.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Bogoliubov sound and dispersive short waves.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Nonlinear density pressure; not finite-strain hardening.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Linearization gives acoustic dispersion.

candidates.name: Harmonic crystal/phonon lattice
candidates.mechanism: Discrete sites coupled by quadratic neighbour springs generate collective phonons.
candidates.natural_basis: Crystalline solids near equilibrium.
candidates.representation: E=sum_i p_i^2/(2m)+1/2 sum_ij u_i K_ij u_j
candidates.waves: Acoustic and optical dispersive branches.
candidates.recovery: Exact in the harmonic idealization.
candidates.hardening: None; harmonic tangent is constant.
candidates.finite_deformation: Invalid at large displacement without nonlinear potentials.
candidates.weak_field: Continuum long-wave limit is Hookean.
candidates.large_deformation: Brillouin-zone dispersion and lattice anisotropy.
candidates.strengths: Transparent origin of waves and neighbour coupling.
candidates.weaknesses: Inventing sites/atoms is forbidden; introduces spacing and preferred lattice.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Only its homogenized continuum interaction structure is comparable.

evaluation.recovery: Exact in the harmonic idealization.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Acoustic and optical dispersive branches.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: None; harmonic tangent is constant.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Continuum long-wave limit is Hookean.

candidates.name: Fermi-Pasta-Ulam nonlinear lattice
candidates.mechanism: Neighbour springs include cubic/quartic nonlinearities, producing amplitude-dependent waves.
candidates.natural_basis: Anharmonic crystals and canonical nonlinear-lattice dynamics.
candidates.waves: Nonlinear dispersion, mode coupling, solitons and recurrences.
candidates.recovery: Conservative; recovery depends on phase/mode distribution.
candidates.hardening: Positive quartic terms harden at large amplitude.
candidates.finite_deformation: Large bond strain limited by potential validity.
candidates.weak_field: Harmonic long-wave limit.
candidates.large_deformation: Strong nonlinearity; cubic terms can destabilize one branch.
candidates.strengths: Joins neighbour coupling and progressive hardening minimally.
candidates.weaknesses: Discrete sites and coefficients violate ontology/FP-6 if taken literally.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Its continuum gradient-hyperelastic limit is an admissible analogy only.

evaluation.recovery: Conservative; recovery depends on phase/mode distribution.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Nonlinear dispersion, mode coupling, solitons and recurrences.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Positive quartic terms harden at large amplitude.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Harmonic long-wave limit.

candidates.name: Central pair-potential continuum
candidates.mechanism: Distance-dependent conservative pair forces create equilibrium spacing and elastic moduli.
candidates.natural_basis: Molecular crystals, colloids and particle networks.
candidates.representation: E=1/2 sum_{i!=j} V(|x_i-x_j|) or continuum double integral
candidates.interaction: Force is the distance derivative of V.
candidates.waves: Phonon-like waves about a stable minimum.
candidates.recovery: Conservative return locally.
candidates.hardening: Depends on anharmonic curvature of V.
candidates.weak_field: Hessian at equilibrium gives elastic constants.
candidates.large_deformation: May soften, fracture or collapse outside stable well.
candidates.strengths: Clear conservative origin of neighbour forces.
candidates.weaknesses: Requires constituents, pair distance and interaction scale absent from frozen ontology.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Only the symmetric nonlocal-kernel limit can be retained.

evaluation.recovery: Conservative return locally.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Phonon-like waves about a stable minimum.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Depends on anharmonic curvature of V.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Hessian at equilibrium gives elastic constants.

candidates.name: Open-cell/bending-dominated foam
candidates.mechanism: Cell ribs bend, buckle and densify under compression.
candidates.natural_basis: Polymer, metal and biological cellular solids.
candidates.waves: Elastic waves with band/dispersion effects.
candidates.recovery: Recoverable only before buckling damage/plasticity.
candidates.hardening: Densification produces strong compressive hardening after a plateau.
candidates.finite_deformation: Very large compressive strain through cell collapse.
candidates.weak_field: Low effective moduli controlled by relative density.
candidates.large_deformation: Nonconvex plateau, buckling and hysteresis common.
candidates.strengths: Topology controls response and permits densification hardening.
candidates.weaknesses: Cells, voids and damage are extra structure; tension/compression asymmetry.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Homogenized reversible branch only; literal foam ontology excluded.

evaluation.recovery: Recoverable only before buckling damage/plasticity.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Elastic waves with band/dispersion effects.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Densification produces strong compressive hardening after a plateau.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Low effective moduli controlled by relative density.

candidates.name: Affine entropic network
candidates.mechanism: A connected random network deforms approximately affinely and stores energy in strands.
candidates.natural_basis: Rubber networks, gels and cytoskeletal networks.
candidates.interaction: Network node forces homogenize to stress.
candidates.waves: Elastic waves after homogenization.
candidates.recovery: Reversible ideal network.
candidates.hardening: Finite chains or nonaffinity can harden.
candidates.weak_field: Isotropic orientation average yields standard elastic tangent.
candidates.large_deformation: May become nonaffine, lose stability or approach chain limits.
candidates.strengths: Explains convergence of many network models to invariant hyperelasticity.
candidates.weaknesses: Microscopic strands and distribution are not PBUF primitives.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Use only the homogenized invariant energy class.

evaluation.recovery: Reversible ideal network.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Elastic waves after homogenization.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Finite chains or nonaffinity can harden.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Isotropic orientation average yields standard elastic tangent.

candidates.name: Rate-independent plasticity with work hardening
candidates.mechanism: Yielding produces irreversible strain; the yield surface expands with accumulated plastic work.
candidates.natural_basis: Dislocation motion and irreversible rearrangement in solids.
candidates.stored_energy: Elastic energy W(Fe) plus dissipation, not total-strain potential.
candidates.interaction: Local stress plus plastic flow rule.
candidates.neighbour_coupling: No intrinsic neighbour coupling in classical plasticity.
candidates.waves: Elastic precursor waves; plastic waves/shocks possible.
candidates.recovery: Does not recover plastic deformation.
candidates.hardening: Yes, through evolving yield strength, not reversible tangent hardening.
candidates.weak_field: Elastic tangent before yield.
candidates.large_deformation: History, path dependence and dissipation dominate.
candidates.weaknesses: Fails reversible recovery and requires internal history variables.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Work hardening is not the frozen progressive elastic hardening requirement.

evaluation.recovery: Does not recover plastic deformation.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Elastic precursor waves; plastic waves/shocks possible.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Yes, through evolving yield strength, not reversible tangent hardening.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Elastic tangent before yield.

candidates.name: Continuum damage/phase-field fracture
candidates.mechanism: A damage field progressively degrades stiffness and regularizes cracks.
candidates.natural_basis: Microcracking, decohesion and fracture.
candidates.waves: Waves attenuate/scatter as damage grows.
candidates.recovery: Irreversibility constraint d_dot>=0 prevents recovery.
candidates.hardening: Softening, not progressive elastic hardening.
candidates.finite_deformation: Handles cracks and large deformation in variants.
candidates.weak_field: Undamaged tangent can match elasticity.
candidates.large_deformation: Loss of stiffness and localization; finite fracture energy.
candidates.weaknesses: Adds damage field, length and irreversible evolution.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Violates recovery and minimal frozen state as a complete mechanism.

evaluation.recovery: Irreversibility constraint d_dot>=0 prevents recovery.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Waves attenuate/scatter as damage grows.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Softening, not progressive elastic hardening.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Undamaged tangent can match elasticity.

candidates.name: Shape-memory phase-transforming solid
candidates.mechanism: Stress/temperature switches among crystal variants, permitting recoverable transformation strain.
candidates.natural_basis: Shape-memory alloys and martensitic transformations.
candidates.representation: Free energy with multiple wells in strain, temperature and phase fractions
candidates.interaction: Local stress; gradient interfacial terms in regularized models.
candidates.waves: Complex dispersive/attenuated waves across phases.
candidates.recovery: Recovery requires thermal or stress cycling; hysteretic.
candidates.hardening: Plateaus and subsequent hardening, not monotone single-well response.
candidates.weak_field: One well has an elastic tangent.
candidates.large_deformation: Multiple equilibria and hysteresis.
candidates.weaknesses: Requires temperature, phases and internal variables not in frozen minimal state.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Cannot enter without authorized phase/thermal state enlargement.

evaluation.recovery: Recovery requires thermal or stress cycling; hysteretic.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Complex dispersive/attenuated waves across phases.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Plateaus and subsequent hardening, not monotone single-well response.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: One well has an elastic tangent.

candidates.name: Jammed granular/contact network
candidates.mechanism: Repulsive contacts form a load-bearing network above a jamming threshold.
candidates.natural_basis: Dense grains, emulsions and foams.
candidates.representation: E=sum_contacts V(overlap) for frictionless soft particles
candidates.stored_energy: Contact energy; friction adds nonconservative forces.
candidates.waves: Acoustic modes emerge above jamming; anomalous soft modes near threshold.
candidates.recovery: Frictionless elastic contacts may recover; rearrangements/hysteresis generally do not.
candidates.hardening: Hertz contacts harden with overlap; network changes can soften.
candidates.weak_field: Moduli vanish or scale near the jamming point.
candidates.large_deformation: Non-smooth topology changes and marginal stability.
candidates.weaknesses: Requires particles, contacts and evolving topology forbidden by the mission.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Continuum scaling may inspire tests but cannot be imported literally.

evaluation.recovery: Frictionless elastic contacts may recover; rearrangements/hysteresis generally do not.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Acoustic modes emerge above jamming; anomalous soft modes near threshold.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Hertz contacts harden with overlap; network changes can soften.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Moduli vanish or scale near the jamming point.

candidates.name: Magnetoelastic continuum
candidates.mechanism: Deformation and a magnetic field exchange energy, producing field-tunable stress.
candidates.natural_basis: Magnetorheological elastomers and ferromagnetic solids.
candidates.interaction: Mechanical stress and Maxwell-type field equations.
candidates.waves: Coupled magnetoacoustic waves.
candidates.recovery: Potentially reversible without hysteresis.
candidates.hardening: Field can stiffen or soften depending on coupling.
candidates.weak_field: At zero field can reduce to ordinary elasticity.
candidates.large_deformation: Stability requires joint Hessian positivity; hysteresis common.
candidates.weaknesses: Adds an independent field and electromagnetic ontology explicitly disallowed.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Mathematical comparison only; no EM ontology may be assumed.

evaluation.recovery: Potentially reversible without hysteresis.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Coupled magnetoacoustic waves.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Field can stiffen or soften depending on coupling.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: At zero field can reduce to ordinary elasticity.

candidates.name: Liquid-crystal elastomer
candidates.mechanism: A polymer network couples strain to an orientational director, enabling soft modes.
candidates.natural_basis: Cross-linked liquid-crystal polymers.
candidates.waves: Coupled acoustic and orientational modes.
candidates.recovery: May recover but can have domains/hysteresis.
candidates.hardening: Often soft or semisoft rather than progressively hardening.
candidates.weak_field: Director relaxation changes the apparent tangent.
candidates.large_deformation: Nonconvex multiwell behavior and domain formation.
candidates.weaknesses: Independent director violates minimal isotropy/state.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Excluded unless orientation is derived from the existing q/C field.

evaluation.recovery: May recover but can have domains/hysteresis.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Coupled acoustic and orientational modes.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Often soft or semisoft rather than progressively hardening.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Director relaxation changes the apparent tangent.

candidates.name: Negative-stiffness stabilized composite
candidates.mechanism: A locally unstable inclusion is stabilized by a positive host, yielding extreme effective response.
candidates.natural_basis: Buckled structures and phase-transforming inclusions in composites.
candidates.representation: W_eff from host plus nonconvex inclusion energy
candidates.stored_energy: Composite energy can be stable globally despite negative local tangent.
candidates.waves: Unusual dispersion; stability requires positive total dynamic energy.
candidates.recovery: Often metastable and hysteretic.
candidates.hardening: Can switch, soften or show negative incremental stiffness.
candidates.weak_field: Weak effective modulus can be enhanced or approach instability.
candidates.large_deformation: Nonconvexity and sensitivity to boundary conditions.
candidates.weaknesses: Local negative tangent fails PBUF stability/progressive-hardening gates.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Useful elimination control, not an admissible complete law.

evaluation.recovery: Often metastable and hysteretic.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Unusual dispersion; stability requires positive total dynamic energy.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Can switch, soften or show negative incremental stiffness.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Weak effective modulus can be enhanced or approach instability.

candidates.name: Locally resonant elastic metamaterial
candidates.mechanism: Internal resonators exchange energy with a host to create band gaps and dynamic effective mass.
candidates.natural_basis: Sonic/phononic architected materials.
candidates.representation: Host elasticity coupled to oscillator fields m_r q_ddot+k_r(q-u)=0
candidates.interaction: Local resonator-host coupling plus host neighbour interaction.
candidates.waves: Strongly dispersive waves and stop bands.
candidates.recovery: Elastic idealization recovers; damping can be added.
candidates.hardening: Not amplitude hardening unless resonators are nonlinear.
candidates.finite_deformation: Finite motion variants exist but usually linearized.
candidates.weak_field: Long-wave effective parameters are frequency dependent.
candidates.large_deformation: Resonances can yield negative effective dynamic parameters.
candidates.weaknesses: Adds resonator degrees, masses, frequencies and microstructure.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Cannot be native without deriving internal modes from existing state.

evaluation.recovery: Elastic idealization recovers; damping can be added.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Strongly dispersive waves and stop bands.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Not amplitude hardening unless resonators are nonlinear.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Long-wave effective parameters are frequency dependent.

candidates.name: Gradient hyperelastic hybrid
candidates.mechanism: A progressively hardening local invariant energy is combined with positive gradient interaction.
candidates.natural_basis: Established strain-gradient nonlinear elasticity.
candidates.interaction: Fourth/second-order variational operator depending on chosen gradient measure.
candidates.waves: Dispersive nonlinear elastic waves with positive inertia.
candidates.recovery: Reversible on a stable branch.
candidates.hardening: Inherited from Phi; can be polynomial, exponential or barrier.
candidates.finite_deformation: Finite deformation if gradient term is objective.
candidates.weak_field: Common PBUF tangent plus q-dependent correction.
candidates.large_deformation: Combines large-amplitude hardening with short-scale stiffening.
candidates.strengths: Fills both LAB-002 constitutive slots in one variational functional.
candidates.weaknesses: Length scale, objective gradient and boundary data remain underived.
candidates.compatibility_reason: A family for future testing, not a preferred model.

evaluation.recovery: Reversible on a stable branch.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Dispersive nonlinear elastic waves with positive inertia.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Inherited from Phi; can be polynomial, exponential or barrier.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Common PBUF tangent plus q-dependent correction.

candidates.name: Fibre-reinforced matrix hybrid
candidates.mechanism: A soft isotropic matrix shares load with hardening oriented fibres.
candidates.natural_basis: Biological tissues and composites.
candidates.interaction: Local stress; network extensions add coupling.
candidates.neighbour_coupling: None intrinsically in homogenized local form.
candidates.waves: Anisotropic waves.
candidates.recovery: Reversible idealization.
candidates.hardening: Recruitment/finite fibres progressively harden.
candidates.weak_field: Isotropic tangent possible only for isotropic orientation ensemble.
candidates.large_deformation: Strong anisotropy and locking at large stretch.
candidates.strengths: Explains independent convergence to exponential/barrier responses.
candidates.weaknesses: Structural tensors are additional state data.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Conditional only if fibre directions emerge from C/q without ontology change.

evaluation.recovery: Reversible idealization.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Anisotropic waves.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Recruitment/finite fibres progressively harden.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Isotropic tangent possible only for isotropic orientation ensemble.

candidates.name: Visco-hyperelastic solid
candidates.mechanism: A finite-strain hyperelastic equilibrium network combines with relaxing overstress branches.
candidates.natural_basis: Rubbers and soft tissues with rate dependence.
candidates.stored_energy: Equilibrium energy plus branch free energies and dissipation.
candidates.neighbour_coupling: No intrinsic length unless gradient terms are added.
candidates.waves: Damped nonlinear elastic waves.
candidates.recovery: Equilibrium branch recovers; transient branches relax.
candidates.hardening: Can inherit progressive hardening from W_eq.
candidates.weak_field: Equilibrium tangent can match PBUF.
candidates.large_deformation: Rate-dependent hysteresis and multiple relaxation times.
candidates.weaknesses: Adds internal variables and clock scales.
candidates.compatibility_reason: Only as a later duration-compatible dissipative completion.

evaluation.recovery: Equilibrium branch recovers; transient branches relax.
evaluation.wave_propagation: Damped nonlinear elastic waves.
evaluation.progressive_hardening: Can inherit progressive hardening from W_eq.
evaluation.weak_field_compatibility: Equilibrium tangent can match PBUF.
